reporter_statement_translation: On September 4 at about 3:20 p.m., I saw my supervisor remove the guard from press P-14 while the line was running. I stopped my station and said the machine was not safe. The supervisor told me to restart and said that near misses should not be entered because the team had already missed its target. I am afraid my schedule will be cut because I reported this.
requested_protection: No direct contact from the reported supervisor during initial review
